title: Aft Fuselage Fuel Cell
summary: Aft center-fuselage integral fuel cell feeding the twin F119 engine feed tanks.
role: Balances aft center-of-gravity shift during supersonic flight and feeds main engine fuel pumps.
materials: Sealed titanium and carbon-bismaleimide composite wet structure.
